title: State Bicycle Co 4130 8 Speed Road
content:
State Bicycle Co has been listening to the people with its two latest releases, including its 4130 8 Speed Road ($649.99)…

Affordable at $649.99 and with rim brakes, this new road bike is a budget-friendly beginner road bike built to handle double duty as a commuter. Double-butted chromoly, timeless road aesthetics, and a price that can’t be matched. Integrated shifters put shifting where your hands already are, 38 mm tires handle imperfect roads, and rim brakes keep it light, low-maintenance, and easy for almost anyone to understand. Every interface uses common standards for easy sourcing, replacement, and upgrades. The perfect entry-level road bike or commuter.

The icing on the rim brake cake: complete bikes start at only $649.99

Specs:

  • 1 ⅛ Steerer
  • 68mm English Threaded BB Shell
  • Integrated 8-speed Shifters (42t front / 11-28 rear)
  • Double-Butted Steel Frame and Fork
  • 38 mm Tires
  • Long reach rim brake calipers
  • Colors: Sea Foam / Sapphire & Chrome / Black & Tan
  • MSRP: $649.99

See more at State Bicycle Co.
